title: ElevenLabs (speech)
description: ElevenLabs text-to-speech as gohort's voice, declared as a service: the request, the voice and the reply are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Get an API key at elevenlabs.io (Profile > API keys). The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors, run Test on its row, then pick it under Capabilities > Speech (TTS). ElevenLabs bills in credits by the character, so no price is declared: the connector shows its calls as unpriced until you add a cost to its spec (per_unit with unit character).

questions.name: api_key
questions.label: ElevenLabs API key
questions.help: Stored in the credential's secret store, never in the connector.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the speech settings list it by this name.

questions.name: voice
questions.label: Voice id
questions.help: An ElevenLabs voice id; the speech settings' Voice overrides it when set.
